narrative:
## What was built
A read-only endpoint, `GET /api/v1/urls/{code}/qr`, that renders the short URL as a PNG or SVG QR code, generated in-process with ZXing core.

## How it was validated
The full shortener test suite ran against a throw-away database schema. New tests decode the generated PNG back to the short URL and check the SVG is well-formed, the size bounds, and the 404/410 behaviour.

## Human decisions
A person approved the design and the new dependency, the controller that adds the endpoint, and this release.
risks: ZXing core is a new third-party dependency (pinned, allowlisted group)
Responses are cached for five minutes by clients, so a deleted link can still show its QR code briefly in a browser cache
